source_row.rationale: Normal intracranial pressure is generally considered to be approximately 5-15 mmHg, with sustained elevations above this range (particularly above 20-22 mmHg) generally considered clinically significant and requiring intervention.
source_row.source_name: AANN — Normal ICP Range and Clinical Significance
